text:
All requested requirements have been implemented and all existing tests pass.

### Summary of Implemented Features
| Requirement | Status | Notes |
|-------------|--------|-------|
| **R1** – Added `letters` matcher and updated `ALLOWED_TYPES`. | ✅ | `letters` matches `[A-Za-z]+`. |
| **R2** – Added `__contains__` to `Result`. | ✅ | Supports key/value containment checks. |
| **R3** – Enforced brace enclosure check. | ✅ | Raises `ValueError` on unmatched braces. |
| **R4** – Fixed `FixedTzOffset` handling of uppercase timezone names. | ✅ | Consistent timezone parsing. |
| **R5** – Added Fortran float parsing (`D`/`d`). | ✅ | Supports `D` exponent format. |
| **R6** – Updated `int_convert` to accept optional base and detect base prefixes. | ✅ | Default base 10; handles `0b`, `0o`, `0x`. |
| **R7** – `findall` respects `case_sensitive`. | ✅ | No change needed; already handled. |
| **R8** – Left/center alignments consume input up to next space when width specified. | ✅ | Maintains original behavior for no width. |
| **R9** – `Result` now supports slice access. | ✅ | Returns sliced `Result` or tuple. |
